research_questions.RQ1: Can visible incentives, verification and reputation improve truthful, independent and verifiable semantic reports under strategic behavior?
research_questions.RQ2: Can a leader dynamically organize agents, message visibility, topology and verification budget to obtain reliable consensus at lower cost?

consensus_definition.decision_consensus: agreement sufficient to execute a ranked recommendation decision
consensus_definition.evidence_consensus: compatibility and verification of the supporting evidence
consensus_definition.residual_dissent: preserved high-value objections that remain after the decision

online_feature_policy: The planner may use only request-time observable features; ground truth and post-hoc utility are forbidden.
system_boundary: tvos-agent is read-only scenario reference; this implementation is greenfield.
model_constraint: A single DeepSeek API key and model endpoint back all logical LLM agents; deterministic retrieval, verification, and no-key fallback remain available.
